sQuery: SELECT TOP 300000 s.source_id, s.ra, s.dec, s.ecl_lat, s.parallax, s.phot_g_mean_mag, ap.teff_gspphot, ap.radius_gspphot, ap.lum_flame, ap.mass_flame, ap.logg_gspphot FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source AS s JOIN gaiadr3.astrophysical_parameters AS ap ON s.source_id = ap.source_id WHERE s.parallax > 20.0 AND s.phot_g_mean_mag < 13.0 AND ap.teff_gspphot IS NOT NULL AND ap.radius_gspphot IS NOT NULL AND ap.lum_flame IS NOT NULL
sSource: Gaia DR3 (gaia_source x astrophysical_parameters), ESA archive TAP
